name: Microsoft
tagline: Cloud and software giant caught in the 'AI replaces software' sell-off.
weaknesses: Huge AI capex is weighing on free cash flow
Heavy reliance on the OpenAI relationship
thesis: Enterprise lock-in across Office, Azure and security
Down sharply this year (reported about -17% YTD), so the multiple has come in
Cash generation funds AI build-out without strain
moat: Switching costs and scale. Rebuilding an organisation's Microsoft stack is costly and risky, so customers rarely leave.
outlook: If AI spending starts to show up in Azure growth and Copilot revenue, today's discount closes. The risk is a long period of heavy spending before returns appear.
news: Fell 2.3% on Nov 17 as selling spread across software stocks.
risks: AI capex fails to earn its cost of capital
changeMind: Azure growth re-accelerating would make it a Strong Buy
Capex rising while FCF keeps falling would drop it to Hold

sources.title: Motley Fool: Stock market today, Nov 17 2026

method: Quick screen, not a full analysis: moat, red flags, headline ratios and relative valuation.
